name: sqrt
comment: Sig: r = sqrt(...). Element-wise libm-backed primitive (SIMD via Highway hn::Sqrt). Negative scalar promotes to complex: sqrt(-4)==0+2i (real(zn)=0, imag(zn)=2). ARRAY promotion (fixed 2026-06-05): any negative element promotes the WHOLE array — sqrt([-1 4 -9])=[0+1i 2+0i 0+3i] (previously the negatives became real NaN). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b.
